verdict.rationale: Orama is a client-embeddable full-text search library marketed as adding "fast, relevant search" to your application, with typo tolerance and BM25 ranking that suit search-as-you-type use. The pack never documents per-keystroke querying, prefix matching, or millisecond latency, so the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit as-you-type/prefix search documentation, published millisecond latency figures or benchmarks, independent hands-on corroboration of response times.
